note: Large, well-treed campground in Peter Lougheed PP near the Kananaskis Lakes, with an on-site manager and caretaker, amphitheatre and interpretive programs, a playground, hiking trails and paved bike paths. Power/water sites are in Loops A and B. Water services run about mid-May to early September, weather permitting. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 59 unserviced + 67 power/water (30-amp) sites at $31/$47, season May 7 - Oct 12 (2026), reservable 90 days ahead, token showers, flush toilets. Added electric 30, sewer false, max length 61, showers/toilets; note rewritten without counts. Dump left as stored (page ambiguous).
